title: in/at/on (position) 3
subtitle: Здания, города и адреса: at the cinema, in Rome, arrive in / at

theory.text: О зданиях обычно говорим at, когда важно, что человек там по делу или на событии: at the cinema, at the airport, at the hotel, at the doctor's, at Kate's (= у Кейт дома). in подчёркивает, что мы именно внутри здания: It was hot in the cinema.

items: Для гостиниц и магазинов часто подходят оба варианта: stay at / in a hotel, work in / at a bank.
Город, страна — in: in Rome, in Japan. Но точка на маршруте — at: Does this train stop at Paris?
Адрес с номером дома — at: She lives at 12 Park Road.

head: Глагол
Куда
Пример
rows: We arrived at the hotel / at the party.
How did you get to the airport?

theory.text: Никогда не говорите arrive to! «Приехать в Лондон» — arrive in London, «приехать в аэропорт» — arrive at the airport. А «у врача» и «у сестры» — at the doctor's, at my sister's.

items.ru: Вчера вечером мы были в кино.
en: We were at the cinema last night.
We were at the cinema yesterday evening.
Last night we were at the cinema.
It was cold in the cinema.
I'll meet you at the airport.
There are a lot of shops in the airport.
There are many shops in the airport.
We stayed at a nice hotel.
We stayed in a nice hotel.
We stayed at a good hotel.
I was at the doctor's.
I've been at the doctor's.

items.ru: Вчера я был у Анны дома.
en: I was at Anna's yesterday.
I was at Anna's house yesterday.
Yesterday I was at Anna's.
I stayed at my sister's.
I stayed at my sister's house.
I stayed at my sister's place.
Mum is at the hospital visiting Dad.
My mum is at the hospital visiting Dad.
Mom is at the hospital visiting Dad.
We saw Kate at the theatre.
We saw Kate at the theater.

items.ru: Я весь день был на конференции.
en: I was at a conference all day.
I was at the conference all day.
We were at a football match.
We were at the football match.
The children are at school.
The kids are at school.
Sarah works in a bank.
Sarah works at a bank.
They live in Rome.

items.ru: Мы живём в доме пятнадцать по Парк-роуд.
en: We live at 15 Park Road.
We live at fifteen Park Road.

items.ru: (по пути) Этот поезд останавливается в Париже?
en: Does this train stop at Paris?
Does this train stop in Paris?

items.ru: Мы прибыли в Лондон рано утром.
en: We arrived in London early in the morning.
We arrived in London early this morning.
When did you arrive in Japan?
When did you get to Japan?

items.ru: Мы приехали в аэропорт в шесть.
en: We arrived at the airport at six.
We got to the airport at six.

items.ru: Во сколько ты пришёл на вечеринку?
en: What time did you arrive at the party?
What time did you get to the party?

items.ru: Я добрался до отеля поздно вечером.
en: I got to the hotel late in the evening.
I arrived at the hotel late in the evening.
How did you get to the station?

items.ru: Я купил это в магазине на углу.
en: I bought it at the shop on the corner.
I bought it in the shop on the corner.
I bought it from the shop on the corner.
